pages.title: Privacy

Privacy

How Kazoe Books handles information.

Kazoe stores the sales you record so it can build your closing reports and exports. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.

You can export or delete your shop data at any time from the app, or by writing to hello@kazoe.example.

pages.title: Features
pages.content:
Features built forthe counter

Kazoe helps independent shops record daily sales, split payment methods, and close the register in one tap. Everything runs on iOS, Android, and the web with clear exports for your accountant.

01

Daily close inone tap

When your shop closes for the evening, wrapping up your daily takings should not involve hours of recalculation. Kazoe consolidates every transaction recorded throughout the trading hours into a single daily summary. With one tap on your mobile device, tablet, or web browser, the register closes, the day locks securely, and the balance reconciles automatically against recorded payment types. Shop owners can finish their shift on time without lingering over mental arithmetic or manual paper ledgers.

02

Continuous saleslog

Every individual item sold or service rendered appears instantly in an unbroken chronological feed. The sales log keeps a clean record of timestamps, quantities, applied discounts, and totals without cluttering your screen. If an item requires correction during trading, adjustments remain transparent and traceable for future audits. You can search previous transactions in seconds during customer visits or review the entire day before completing the final evening balance.

03

Payment-method split

Counters handle diverse payment channels across every business day, including cash, card terminals, contactless devices, and voucher redemptions. Kazoe automatically separates incoming revenue by channel as each transaction is logged. When closing time arrives, the application presents a clear breakdown showing expected cash in drawer alongside digital card settlements. This precise division removes discrepancies before they enter your general ledger, making cash reconciliation straightforward and verifiable.

04

Custom taxrates

Tax compliance should never require complicated configuration or manual percentage calculations at checkout. Kazoe lets you establish local tax rates during your initial setup and assign them directly to specific categories or product lines. As sales occur, the software tracks tax obligations in real time, separating taxable amounts from net figures. When it comes time to file periodic declarations, all tax categories are categorized and ready for formal reporting.

05

Expense receiptscanning

Small expenses like cleaning products, milk, stamps, or packaging supplies often accumulate as loose paper slips behind the counter. With the receipt scanning add-on, staff can capture a photo of paper receipts directly through the phone camera. Kazoe stores up to two hundred photographed receipts per month alongside your operating expenses. Receipts link directly to daily expense records so that paper slips no longer go missing before your bookkeeper reviews the month.

06

Physical stockcounts

Maintaining accurate product counts on shelves prevents surprise inventory shortages and overstocked items. Available on our Shop Plus tier, the stock count feature enables periodic stocktaking straight from your mobile device. Staff members can walk aisles, tally units, and update on-hand quantities without pausing trading or transferring numbers from clipboards to spreadsheets. Discrepancies between expected quantities and physical counts are clearly flagged, keeping your counter operations organized and accurate.

07

Staff loginsand registers

Shops with multiple team members need accountability without complicated administrative steps. Shop Plus supports up to three registers with distinct staff logins, allowing employees to sign in, record sales, and complete shifts on designated terminals. Every transaction records which register processed the payment, maintaining clear operational boundaries. Team members can focus entirely on customer service while store owners retain a consolidated overview of register performance across trading hours.

08

Accountant exportfiles

Preparing your financial records for periodic accounting reviews should never mean sorting through shoeboxes of paper tapes. Kazoe formats all daily closing logs, income summaries, and tax calculations into clean CSV and PDF files. These exports conform to standard accounting requirements, meaning your bookkeeper can import data directly into their preferred ledger software. Handing over monthly or quarterly numbers takes only a couple of clicks, saving time for both you and your accountant.

Ten minutes tonight. One tap every night after.

pages.title: How it works
pages.content:
How it worksin three steps

Configuring Kazoe takes about ten minutes on iOS, Android, or the web. Follow these three practical steps to prepare your registers and complete your first daily close tonight.

01

Step 1: Download and nameyour shop (2 min)

Begin by downloading Kazoe onto your mobile device or opening our application in your desktop browser. Type in the official trading name of your business and establish your store profile. There are no lengthy administrative forms, identity verification procedures, or mandatory hardware integrations to navigate. Within two minutes, your workspace is created, and your counter is prepared to register its first customer transaction with a clean, focused display.

02

Step 2: Add payment methodsand tax rate (5 min)

Next, define how your shop collects funds and handles sales tax. Enter the payment methods you accept at the counter, such as cash drawer, card reader, or vouchers. Input your standard local sales tax rate so Kazoe can calculate gross and net totals automatically as sales are rung up. This five-minute step ensures your financial records stay accurate and that end-of-day balances properly reconcile against your merchant receipts.

03

Step 3: Close your first daywith one tap (3 min)

At closing time, review your daily sales summary directly on screen. Compare the recorded cash and card totals with your drawer count, verify any expense receipts photographed during the shift, and tap once to close the day. In three minutes, the daily record is archived, numbers are locked against accidental changes, and your register is reset for tomorrow morning. Your bookkeeping is finished before you leave the shop.

Ten minutes tonight. One tap every night after.

pages.title: Stories
pages.content:
Shop stories fromthe counter

Real independent shop owners rely on Kazoe to manage daily counter balances and simplify bookkeeping routines. Here is how three businesses turned tedious evening calculations into calm closing moments.

01

Rafael Moreno: Bikerepair shop

Rafael Moreno manages a busy independent bicycle workshop where greasy hands, constant repairs, and walk-in customers keep the counter active from morning until late afternoon. Before adopting Kazoe, Rafael routinely stayed late at his workbench, balancing receipts and tallying cash balances until past nine in the evening. With Kazoe installed on his phone, he stopped counting coins at 9 pm. A quick verification of the card terminal total and drawer cash allows him to close the register in one tap and head home on time.

02

Mei-Ling Chou:Florist

Mei-Ling Chou runs a bustling neighbourhood florist shop where fresh flower deliveries, bespoke bouquets, and seasonal arrangements require continuous counter sales. Preparing quarterly tax documents used to mean spending entire weekends organizing crumpled supplier invoices and paper register rolls. Using Kazoe's Shop plan, Mei-Ling now logs sales directly, records expense receipts by phone, and categorizes local tax rates as transactions occur. Her entire tax quarter is sent in one export to her accountant, turning tax season into a straightforward email exchange.

03

Yusuf Demir:Corner café

At Yusuf Demir's busy corner café, morning espresso rushes and afternoon lunches keep multiple team members cycling behind the counter. Before implementing Kazoe's Shop Plus plan, handoffs between morning and afternoon shifts often caused confusion over drawer totals and card payments. Now, two baristas work across scheduled shifts with separate staff logins, producing one closing report at the end of the day. Yusuf reviews the reconciled totals in minutes, confident that every coffee, pastry, and tip is accounted for cleanly.

Ten minutes tonight. One tap every night after.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
Frequently askedquestions

Here are answers to common questions about setup, daily reconciliations, and bookkeeping exports. If you need additional assistance, our Lisbon support team is ready to help.

Getting started

01

How long doesinitial setup take?

Setting up Kazoe takes about ten minutes from start to finish. You begin by downloading the application or opening it on the web, naming your shop in two minutes, entering your accepted payment methods and local tax rate in five minutes, and completing your first daily close in three minutes. There is no technical hardware configuration or credit card requirement involved, so you can start trading immediately.

02

Which operating systems anddevices are supported?

Kazoe operates natively across iOS and Android smartphones and tablets, as well as through modern web browsers on desktop computers. You do not need dedicated point-of-sale hardware or proprietary card terminal readers. Any modern phone or laptop can serve as your counter register, and your store records synchronize automatically across connected devices whenever an internet connection is active, ensuring your staff always sees identical numbers.

03

Is there a freetrial for paid plans?

Yes. We offer a full 30-day free trial on any of our paid plans, including Shop, Shop Plus, and Multi-store. You do not need to provide a credit card to activate your trial period. During the thirty days, you can test daily closing, manage staff logins, and create accountant exports under everyday trading conditions to ensure Kazoe suits your counter operations perfectly.

04

What happens if Iexceed Starter plan limits?

Our Starter tier is completely free of charge and permits one register and up to 300 sales per month with daily closing features. If your shop grows beyond three hundred monthly transactions, you can easily upgrade to our Shop plan for €9 per month. Upgrading unlocks unlimited sales, tax-period exports, and historical archive access without interrupting your daily sales log or altering your store settings.

Money andtax

05

How does the dailyclosing routine work?

At the end of trading, opening the close screen presents a summary of all sales recorded during the day, split by cash, card, and other accepted payment methods. You verify that the cash in your drawer matches the recorded amount and confirm your card terminal settlement total. Once verified, you tap close once, and Kazoe locks the day's record to prevent accidental modifications.

06

How are differenttax rates configured?

During your initial setup, you can establish the standard tax rates applicable to your business. You can assign default tax percentages across item categories, allowing taxable goods and reduced-rate products to calculate correctly upon checkout. As transactions proceed, Kazoe segregates sales figures and collected tax amounts in real time, making quarterly returns and end-of-year tax declarations straightforward for your accounting advisor to review and submit on time.

07

How does expensereceipt scanning work?

Our receipt scanning add-on costs €3 per month and allows your team to photograph paper receipts using a phone camera. The system archives up to 200 photographed receipts monthly, attaching them directly to your recorded expenses. This feature keeps loose supplier receipts neatly organized and matched with expense entries, avoiding lost paperwork when preparing quarterly documentation for your accountant to review.

08

What does the accountantseat add-on provide?

The Accountant seat is an optional add-on priced at €4 per month. It creates a dedicated, read-only login for your bookkeeper or certified accountant. Through this portal, your financial professional can independently inspect transaction logs, review daily closing records, and download CSV or PDF summaries without possessing permissions to modify shop settings, process counter sales, or alter historical figures in your register.

Account anddata

09

Which export fileformats are available?

Kazoe exports all bookkeeping records, sales histories, and daily closing sheets in standardized CSV and PDF formats. CSV files are formatted cleanly for direct import into popular spreadsheet software or general ledger tools. PDF exports produce legible, structured closing reports ideal for physical recordkeeping or direct email delivery to your certified accountant during monthly and quarterly tax filing periods.

10

Can multiple staff membersshare one account?

On the Shop Plus plan, priced at €19 per month, you can configure up to three registers with unique staff logins. Team members log in under their individual names to record sales and manage daily shifts. This structure maintains full staff accountability, prevents register confusion during shift changes, and provides store owners with clear insight into individual register performance throughout regular business trading hours.

11

How does the annualbilling discount work?

When you choose annual billing for any paid subscription, you receive two months free compared to month-to-month invoicing. Billing occurs as a single annual payment, locking in your subscription rate for twelve full months. You retain complete flexibility to activate add-on seats or upgrade your tier at any point as your shop expands, with unused balances credited proportionately.

12

What support hours doesthe Lisbon team maintain?

Our support team operates from our studio in Lisbon, Portugal, maintaining office hours Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 Lisbon time. We deliver remote support by email via hello@kazoe.example, with replies provided within one business day. Whether you need setup assistance or export guidance, support lead Amara Okoye and our Lisbon team are available to assist your shop during weekday trading hours.

Ten minutes tonight. One tap every night after.

pages.title: About Kazoe

About Kazoe

Kazoe was founded in 2022 by a small team based in Lisbon, Portugal. We create calm, focused bookkeeping software designed specifically for independent counter businesses.

01

Founded in Lisbonin 2022

Kazoe began in 2022 from our studio at Rua da Prata 112, 1100-420 Lisboa. After watching independent shopkeepers spend their evenings sorting paper receipts and recalculating cash balances, we set out to build software that removes friction from daily store operations. Our mission is centered around one clear operational promise: allowing shop owners to close the day in one tap and spend their evenings away from register paperwork.

02

The teambehind Kazoe

Our core team of four brings together deep experience in product design, engineering, customer care, and accounting standards. Inês Carvalho serves as co-founder leading product design. Tomás Weber serves as co-founder leading software engineering. Amara Okoye leads customer support from our Lisbon studio. Lena Fischer serves as bookkeeping advisor and certified accountant, ensuring every calculation and file export adheres strictly to professional standards.

03

Calm and exactbookkeeping tools

We design software that stays quiet and dependable behind the counter. Instead of overwhelming shop owners with complex menus and unnecessary metrics, Kazoe focuses on what matters most: logging daily transactions, separating payment methods, and delivering clear tax-period exports. Initial setup takes about ten minutes on iOS, Android, or the web, enabling retailers to establish organized accounting practices without undergoing lengthy operational training or buying expensive proprietary equipment.

04

Responsive, personalsupport

We believe business software should be accompanied by accessible human support. Our team works remotely from Lisbon, providing assistance from Monday to Friday between 09:00 and 18:00 Lisbon time. When you send an email to hello@kazoe.example, Amara Okoye and our support team reply within one business day. We answer practical questions directly, helping your shop maintain accurate books without automated chatbots or ticket queues.

Ten minutes tonight. One tap every night after.

pages.title: For accountants

For accountants

Kazoe delivers structured bookkeeping data, balanced payment splits, and clean tax period exports for accounting professionals. Provide your small retail clients with a simple counter tool that saves hours of reconciliation work.

Dedicated accountantseat add-on

Instead of waiting for clients to compile receipts or manually export files, you can access verified closing reports, transaction logs, and tax summaries whenever your schedule requires. 02

Standardized CSV andPDF tax exports

Kazoe formats all store data for seamless accounting handoffs. Daily closing records, sales breakdowns, and tax tallies export directly to standardized CSV and PDF files. CSV exports match standard spreadsheet and general ledger schemas, eliminating manual data entry and formatting errors. PDF summaries provide clean, legible documentation of quarterly and monthly turnover, itemized by payment channel and assigned tax percentages for rapid compliance verification.

03

Accounting advisor perspectivefrom Lena Fischer

As Kazoe's bookkeeping advisor and a certified accountant, Lena Fischer designed our reporting architecture around the daily reality of tax compliance. Having reviewed countless disorganized client ledgers, Lena ensured that Kazoe records tax breakdowns in real time and prevents retroactive tampering with closed register days. The result is clean, verifiable documentation that eliminates stressful tax seasons for small retailers and the accounting professionals who support them.

posts.title: Closing the Counter: Why Evening Bookkeeping Should Take One Tap
posts.excerpt: Kazoe helps independent shops close their daily register in one tap and deliver tidy accounting exports without evening paperwork.
posts.content:
Every evening across cities and high streets, independent shop owners reach the exact same ritual. The front door is locked, the open sign is flipped, and the counter lights remain on. On the wooden surface sits a cash drawer, a card terminal settlement slip, and a stack of loose expense notes from the day's deliveries. For many shopkeepers, this moment marks the beginning of an exhausting second shift: recounting coins, matching merchant slips against notebook entries, and wondering whether their numbers will balance before dinner.

Bookkeeping for a small counter was never supposed to be a second job. When Inês Carvalho and Tomás Weber founded Kazoe in 2022 in Lisbon, Portugal, they set out to address this specific pain point. Working from a studio at Rua da Prata 112 in Lisbon, they observed how independent retailers were forced to choose between complex enterprise accounting suites designed for corporate offices or fragile paper systems that created endless stress at tax time. Along with bookkeeping advisor Lena Fischer, a certified accountant, and support lead Amara Okoye, they designed Kazoe around one clear promise: close the day in one tap.

The core philosophy of Kazoe is that counter software should stay calm and out of the way. Initial setup takes about ten minutes across three simple steps. First, you download the app on iOS, Android, or open it in a web browser, and name your shop in two minutes. Second, you enter your accepted payment channels and local tax rate in five minutes. Third, you complete your first daily close in three minutes. There is no complicated hardware to install, and getting started requires no credit card.

During operating hours, Kazoe maintains a continuous sales log, categorizing every purchase by payment method so cash and card transactions remain clearly separated. When the trading day ends, the app aggregates your takings into a single daily summary. Instead of manually tallying coins and recalculating totals, the shopkeeper reviews the register balance, verifies any photographed expense receipts, and closes the day with one tap.

Real shop owners experience the difference immediately. In his bike repair shop, Rafael Moreno stopped counting coins at 9 pm because his daily drawer balance now takes minutes to reconcile. At her neighbourhood florist, Mei-Ling Chou no longer spends entire weekends sorting receipts; her entire tax quarter is sent in one export directly to her accountant. At Yusuf Demir's corner café, two baristas work across different shifts with distinct staff logins, producing one unified closing report each evening.

When reporting season arrives, Kazoe exports clear CSV and PDF files directly to your accountant. Bookkeepers can also use the dedicated Accountant seat add-on for €4 per month, providing a read-only portal to inspect verified closing logs and tax tallies. With plans ranging from the free Starter plan at €0 for 300 monthly sales, to Shop at €9, Shop Plus at €19 for three registers, and Multi-store at €39 for five locations, independent shops can scale their bookkeeping quietly and calmly. Support is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 Lisbon time, with email replies within one business day. Closing up shop should mean going home, not doing extra paperwork.
